title: The Star That Shed Its Skin — And Left a Perfect Sphere
hook: A star exploded, but instead of a chaotic nebula, it left behind a mathematically perfect sphere — something physics says shouldn't exist.
why_this_can_go_viral: The image of a perfect sphere in space is visually stunning and defies intuition, triggering immediate 'how is this possible' curiosity.

title: The Asteroid That Took a Sharp Turn — Something Steered It
hook: A near-Earth asteroid suddenly changed course without any known gravitational influence — as if something, or someone, altered its trajectory.
why_this_can_go_viral: Implies potential alien technology or hidden planetary defense, sparking intense debate and shareability.

title: The Dark Matter That Caused a Mass Extinction — The Evidence Is in the Ice
hook: Ice cores from Antarctica show a spike in a rare isotope exactly 66 million years ago — coinciding with the dinosaur extinction, and linked to dark matter fallout.
why_this_can_go_viral: Connects a mysterious scientific concept (dark matter) to a well-known extinction event, creating a gripping 'new theory' narrative.

title: The Classified Program That Found a Planet With Artificial Light
hook: Declassified documents reveal a US spy satellite detected an anomalous glow on a rogue planet — light that was not natural, but structured.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines government secrecy, spy tech, and the possibility of alien civilization — a triple threat for viral conspiracy interest.

title: The Gamma Ray Burst That Hit Earth in 2019 — And We Hid the Data
hook: A gamma ray burst from a distant galaxy struck Earth's atmosphere in 2019, but major observatories went silent about the event — what did they see?
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'cover-up' angle triggers distrust and the need to uncover the truth, driving shares and comments.

title: The Dark Matter Filament That Tore a Galaxy Apart
hook: A galaxy in the Virgo cluster is being ripped in half, and the culprit is an invisible thread of dark matter — a cosmic guillotine.
why_this_can_go_viral: Visualizing an invisible force destroying a galaxy is terrifying and visually compelling, perfect for short-form video.

title: The Secret Soviet Base That Tried to Contact a Black Hole
hook: In the 1970s, a buried Soviet bunker aimed a massive antenna at the black hole Cygnus X-1 — and something answered back.
why_this_can_go_viral: Cold War secrecy + black hole communication + a mysterious response is a perfect recipe for viral mystery content.

title: The Comet That Came From Outside the Solar System — And Brought Something With It
hook: The interstellar comet 'Oumuamua wasn't alone — radar data shows a smaller object attached to it, and it was metallic.
why_this_can_go_viral: The idea of an alien probe hitching a ride on a comet is irresistible science fiction made real.

title: The Fermi Paradox Answer: They're Hiding in the Ocean of Europa
hook: New models suggest Jupiter's moon Europa has twice the water of Earth, and if life is there, it may never build technology — but it could be vast and intelligent.
why_this_can_go_viral: Offers a plausible, unsettling resolution to the Fermi paradox — aliens are here but silent in a way we can't detect.

title: The Star That Died and Left a Perfectly Symmetric Cloud of Dust
hook: When a red giant collapsed, it ejected gas into a perfect double-lobed shape — like a butterfly made of plasma, defying entropy.
why_this_can_go_viral: The beauty and order in a violent death create a visually stunning, shareable contrast.

title: The Signal That Was a Countdown — And It Stopped at Zero
hook: For 13 years, a radio source in the Milky Way sent a repeating pattern that counted down like a timer — then in 2022, it went silent.
why_this_can_go_viral: A literal cosmic countdown that ended is the ultimate cliffhanger, generating massive speculation and urgency.

title: The Meteorite That Fell in Siberia — And the Ground Healed Behind It
hook: In 1908, the Tunguska event flattened 80 million trees, but ground samples show the soil regenerated in a pattern unlike any impact — as if something fixed it.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'healing ground' angle introduces a supernatural or technological twist to a classic mystery.

title: The Planet That Reflects 0% Light — A Perfect Black Sphere
hook: An exoplanet absorbs all light that hits it, making it the darkest object in the universe — a perfect black sphere floating in the void.
why_this_can_go_viral: The image of a 'black sphere' is visually striking and mysterious, driving clicks and shares.

title: The Dark Matter That Enables Time Travel — We Have the Math
hook: A physicist has published a paper showing dark matter could create closed time-like curves — allowing messages to be sent backward in time.
why_this_can_go_viral: Combines dark matter, time travel, and scientific legitimacy — a powerful viral cocktail.

title: The Asteroid That Has an Ocean Inside — And Something Is Stirring It
hook: Ceres, a dwarf planet in the asteroid belt, has a subsurface ocean — and recent data shows plumes rising from below, as if something is swimming.
why_this_can_go_viral: Implies alien life in our own solar system, with a creepy 'something moving below' hook.

title: The Star That Is Cannibalizing a Planet — And We See the Remains
hook: A white dwarf star shows traces of heavy metals in its atmosphere — the crushed remains of a planet it ate millions of years ago.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'planet being eaten' narrative is visceral and easily visualized, with a dark poetic quality.

title: The Gamma Ray Burst That Was a Perfect Rectangle on the Sky
hook: A gamma ray burst recorded in 2020 had an emission pattern that formed a perfect rectangle — something that shouldn't happen in random cosmic explosions.
why_this_can_go_viral: The geometric perfection suggests intelligent design or extreme natural rarity, driving curiosity.

title: The Comet That Changed Color — From White to Blood Red
hook: Comet 67P was observed turning from a pale white to deep red as it approached the sun — as if it was bleeding into space.
why_this_can_go_viral: The 'blood' metaphor is powerful and eerie, while the color change suggests something alien or unknown.
